create_open_loop_runner: create an OpenLoopClientRunner that dispatches requests at fixed intervals using a generator
create_closed_loop_runner: create a ClosedLoopClientRunner that sends requests in response to previous RPC responses
start_client_runner: start a ClientRunner to begin dispatching requests from a gRPC client
stop_client_runner: stop a running ClientRunner and clean up the underlying client and threads
review_client_runner_abstraction: review the ClientRunner abstract base class and its OpenLoop and ClosedLoop implementations
